vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-88031
vulnerability.description: MongoDB Go Driver: Data deletion via query-operator injection in GridFS file IDs.

statements.impact_statement: Eventrouter does not depend on mongo-driver: the package appears in neither go.mod nor go.sum, and eventrouter does not use MongoDB. Scanner matches occur via keyword matching on 'mongo' keywords in image metadata, not a dependency relationship. Because the component is absent, eventrouter is not affected by any CVE in go.mongodb.org/mongo-driver; CVE-2026-88031 is the known instance of this pattern, recorded here as the representative case. Confirmed absent from the manifests both before and after PR #69.
